items.q: How unusual was the November 2026 sell-off?
items.a: The S&P was **4.1 standard deviations** below its 50-day average, the **worst week since March 2020**.

items.q: What triggered the huge one-day reversal?
items.a: **Jensen Huang returning to Nvidia**, 11 days after he resigned.

items.q: Why does Graham think recent returns won't last?
items.a: About **14% a year** for 16 years is roughly **double the long-term 7-10%**, and returns revert to the mean.

items.q: How often does a 10% drop become a bear market?
items.a: Only about **35-40%** of the time since the 1920s; **faster drops escalate less**.

items.q: What should a regular investor do?
items.a: **Auto-buy on a schedule**, expect **choppy recoveries**, and don't check if it ruins your day.
